title: Oxva Slim Stick Mint Prefilled Vape Pods
description: These Mint Prefilled Pods for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit deliver a fresh, cooling flavour in a simple, ready-to-use format. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and provides up to 600 puffs with a smooth mouth-to-lung draw. The flavour offers a bright Mint character with a refreshing chill that feels clean and uplifting, perfect for those who prefer a cool, uncluttered vape. Built-in coils provide steady vapour and flavour consistency, while the sealed pod design makes replacements quick, easy, and mess-free. Each pack contains two pods designed for a satisfying, straightforward vape experience with the Slim Stick kit.
